data.one_liner: A temporary alternative to device_preview with updated version dependencies.
data.what_it_does: It is a fork of device_preview that updates version dependencies and migrates to newer versions of freezed without adding new features or improvements.
use_when: You need device_preview functionality but require updated dependency versions.
You want to preview your Flutter app across different device configurations.
avoid_when: You need new features or improvements beyond what the original device_preview offers.
You prefer using the original, un-forked package and its maintenance lifecycle.
strengths: Provides updated version dependencies for device previewing.
Compatible with newer Flutter and Dart versions.
weaknesses: No additional features or improvements will be made as it is strictly a fork for updated dependencies.
